test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Some features of the circulatory system in humans are mentioned below. Select the INCORRECT option.

options.text: Hypertension is caused by constriction of veins
Platelets help in clotting of blood
Lymph is also called tissue fluid

solution:
The correct answer is __**hypertension is caused by constriction of veins**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 1** states that hypertension is caused by constriction of veins, which is incorrect. Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is typically caused by the constriction of arteries, not veins.
 
• **Platelets** do help in clotting of blood, which is correctly mentioned in **Option 2**.
 
• **Lymph** is indeed also called tissue fluid, as mentioned in **Option 3**.
 
• **Capillaries** join to form veins, which is accurately stated in **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hypertension** is a condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high, often due to the narrowing or stiffness of the arteries.
 
• Common causes of hypertension include genetic factors, poor diet, lack of exercise, and excessive alcohol or tobacco use.
 
• Managing hypertension typically involves lifestyle changes and medications to help relax and widen the blood vessels.
 
• Understanding the correct causes of hypertension is crucial for its effective management and treatment.
